egin{example} \end{example}[The Fubini--Study Metric] ↗ ex:complex-projective-spaces ↗ thm:local-section-theorem ↗ thm:group-action-riemannian-submersion 1. ch2:2.30

For $n>0$, let $p:S^{2n+1} o \mathbb {CP}^n$ be the restriction of the span map $\pi :\mathbb C^{n+1}\setminus \{ 0\} o \mathbb {CP}^n$. It is surjective. If $\sigma $ is a local section of $\pi $ and $ u (z)=z/|z|$, then $ ar\sigma = u \circ \sigma $ is a local section of $p$ because $p\circ u =\pi $, so $p$ is a submersion. The $S^1$-action $\lambda \cdot (z^1,\ldots ,z^{n+1})=(\lambda z^1,\ldots ,\lambda z^{n+1})$ on the round sphere is isometric, vertical, and fiber-transitive. Hence Theorem 3 gives a unique metric on $\mathbb {CP}^n$ making $p$ a Riemannian submersion; this is the Fubini--Study metric. \end{example}
